body:
## Symptom

Hosts can test SplitPane keyboard resizing through automation: SplitPane attaches script handlers with `on_key_value("left" / "right" / "up" / "down", ...)`, so `AutomationCommand::Dispatch` of a key event on the separator works. oh-my-byted's GUI selftest drives a SplitPane step this way.

Resizable has no equivalent path. Its keyboard resizing is a GPUI `div().on_key_down` closure inside `ResizableHandlePrimitive` (`resizable.rs:676` on `codex/interaction-runtime-0.1.8`), while `automation_dispatch` (`app.rs:3771`) only walks handlers registered on retained nodes (`dispatch_plan` → Script / Host / Native `UiEventHandler`). Pointer gestures are not dispatchable either, so there is no automation path to resize a Resizable at all. oh-my-byted's floating-window resize is currently covered only by hand.

This comes from reading the code; I have not run a Dispatch against a Resizable handle to see what it returns.

## Ask

Route Resizable keyboard steps through the same retained-handler path SplitPane uses (`on_key_value`, or a `UiEventHandler::Native`), or let automation deliver a real key event to the focused element. Either would make Resizable testable headlessly.

Suggested target: 0.1.9.
title: Resizable keyboard resizing can't be driven by AutomationCommand::Dispatch (native on_key_down), unlike SplitPane
